mutation taskClose.summary: Close a task with a human scientific review decision.
mutation taskClose.behavior: Requires principal kind=user and review_science; task must be awaiting_review. closureDecision must be a supported closure. Multiple accepted candidates require candidateRevisionId. The service builds a bound closeout packet: supported_success must pass frozen-contract evidence gates; supported_failure must pass its failure gate. Closure increments task version and preserves contract/evaluation-cycle provenance.

mutation taskCreate.summary: Create a research task in a selected project or the research inbox.
mutation taskCreate.behavior: Requires read_project and edit_task in the selected project scope. If projectId is absent, the service reuses/creates the research inbox. title, mode and mode-specific inputs are validated; unsupported or incomplete science intent is not filled with invented defaults. Optional idempotencyKey makes retries payload-bound. Resolver-declared capability checks: `CAP_EDIT_TASK`, `CAP_READ_PROJECT`.

mutation taskReopen.summary: Reopen a closed task while preserving its prior closure packet.
mutation taskReopen.behavior: Requires edit_task in the task project. Only closed tasks can reopen and reason must be nonempty. New state is active; closure decision is cleared and evaluation cycle increments. Prior contract/closure/evaluation provenance is retained, rather than rewriting the old review.

mutation taskTransition.summary: Move a task through a permitted workflow transition.
mutation taskTransition.behavior: Requires edit_task in the task project. Supply expectedVersion to detect stale state. toState must be permitted from the current state; closed is rejected here because closure needs taskClose. Returning awaiting_review to active requires a review reason. The version increments and a decision/outbox event is recorded.

worker_environment: Learning workers construct a scrubbed environment: PATH, LANG, LC_ALL, SYSTEMROOT and TMPDIR may be inherited; HF_HOME and XDG_CACHE_HOME point to the per-job cache; PYTHONPATH is restricted to repository source paths; PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1, PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1, TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM=false, HF_HUB_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1, DO_NOT_TRACK=1, WANDB_MODE=disabled, OMP_NUM_THREADS=2 and MKL_NUM_THREADS=2 are set. Normal training is HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 and TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1; the approved model-download job is the exception. Simulation builds its own environment and forwards the explicitly configured LAMMPS path. Native build scripts set CARGO_HOME, CARGO_INCREMENTAL and CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_DEBUG themselves. These are implementation-controlled values, not additional Studio configuration switches; generic upstream library environment variables are outside the application settings contract. CI sets UV_FROZEN=1 in its workflow to enforce the committed dependency lock; this is a workflow-controlled build value. Generic CI-provider environment variables are not additional Studio runtime settings.
